role: The /difficulty command: maps peaceful/easy/normal/hard (or 0..3) to EnumDifficulty and sets it on the server.
scope_reason: Commands never run in this game: the product has no chat text entry (no chat handling in csrc/play/play.c) and no harness path constructs ServerCommandManager (grep of oracle/harness finds none); the behaviors the project needs are the Dev ops of oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Dev.java and csrc/engine/dev.c, not this command system.

members.name: processCommand
members.note: the Dev 'difficulty' op sets surv.difficulty and every replay world's st.difficulty, mirroring MinecraftServer.func_147139_a; the command text path never runs

notes: The death-starve-s1 tape uses one {'op':'difficulty'} Dev entry; test_snapshots.c replays it through dev_apply. Static __OBFID constants are grouped out per the brief.
